# A ward mote: an octahedron of lantern light, 0.24 x 0.26 m, centred on its origin (unlit).
# Generated by make_models.py. Up Z, front -Y.
new
material new Light --base-color 1.0000 0.9333 0.5137 --no-slot --emission 1.0000 0.9333 0.5137
add mesh cone --name Mote --vertices 4 --radius1 0.12 --radius2 0 --depth 0.1300 --location 0 0 0.0650
add mesh cone --name MoteB --vertices 4 --radius1 0.12 --radius2 0 --depth 0.1300 --location 0 0 -0.0650 --rotation 180 0 0
apply --rotation
select Mote MoteB
active Mote
join
material assign Light
export mote.glb
